column3: Brightmouth Allotment Society
Registered charity · Meetings held at the Pavilion, Mill Lane
Minutes of the Committee Meeting, 8 October 2026
The meeting opened at 7.30 pm and the chair welcomed the new members. The minutes of the September meeting were approved without changes.
PresentApologies• Chair• Vice chair• Treasurer• Water officer
• Secretary
• Two plot representatives
Matters arising
1.1 Water supply. The committee reviewed the repairs to the main tank and agreed that:
(a) the new pump will be installed before the first frost;
(b) two taps will be replaced in the lower field, namely
(i) the tap by plot 14;
(ii) the tap by the compost bins;
1.2 Waiting list. There are now 23 households waiting for a plot.
1.3 Winter rules. The notice about bonfires will be posted on the gate.
Treasurer's report
The treasurer reported a balance of £2,140 and no unpaid invoices. Rents for the next year will stay at the current level.
